title: The Virus Alarm
intro: A loud warning fills your screen while you browse. It says your phone is infected.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

screen.context: A full-screen warning popped up in your browser.

msg.text: Your phone is infected with 7 viruses!
Do not close this window or your phone will be locked.

infected.label: A scary virus count
infected.lens: A website cannot see viruses on your phone.
infected.why: Real security software does not warn you through a web page.

call.label: "Call this number now"
call.lens: A real warning never asks you to call a number.
call.why: Pop-ups that give a phone number are the start of a support scam.

lock.label: A threat to lock your phone
lock.why: You can always close the page or the browser.

data.label: Your photos and bank details
data.lens: It names the things you fear losing.

site.label: An odd address
site.lens: safe-phone-scan.live is not your phone's own security tool.
site.why: A site you did not choose cannot scan your phone.

popup.label: A big alert title
popup.lens: An alert with a warning sign.
popup.why: Big warning signs are easy to draw.

pic.label: Warning icon
pic.lens: A triangle with an exclamation mark.

actions.label: Close the browser and scan with my phone's own security tool
Close the page and report the site

block_report.line: You closed the page and reported the site. The browser added it to its warning list.

verify.line: Your phone's own security tool found no viruses. The pop-up was fake. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The "technician" asked you to install a remote app, then moved money from your bank.

what_if.go_ahead: Closing the page was always allowed. A web page cannot detect viruses on your phone.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A pop-up that says "call now" is a scam. Close it, and use only your phone's own security tool.

quick_check.q: A pop-up says your phone has viruses and tells you to call a number now. What do you do?

options.text: Close the page. Use your phone's own security tool if worried

quick_check.explain: Real warnings never ask you to call a number.

hints.nudge: Can a web page really see inside your phone?

rows.k: Do real pop-ups ask you to call?

rows.v: Close the page, and use your own security tool
